name: delegate_mode_gate
description: In ask mode `delegate` is neither offered nor allowed: a hallucinated call is denied by the mode gate and no sub-agent session is started (no extra model request). Old bug: the delegate branch sat in front of the mode gate, so ask/plan mode could spawn sub-agents (and sub-agents could recurse).

model_replies.content: Alt ajan başlatamıyorum; normal moda geçmem gerekir.
